links.source_location: Abstract: U-Net + transformer + cross-attention to fuse initial channel estimates with RSS maps
forward(initial_channel, rss_map): RSS map fed directly into rss_encoder branch
EnhancedCrossAttention fuses channel features with RSS features extracted from RSS map
L_total = L_NMSE + zeta * L_physical; L_physical ties channel power to RSS map reading
ue_positions_noisy.txt: horizontal Gaussian noise N(0,9*I) per GPS-error model Sec. E
Both map RSS image colors to dBm values; ImprovedRSSColorMapper uses actual colormap lookup vs grayscale proxy
Both implement LS pilot-based channel estimation with interpolation
LS-OFDM is the initial estimate stage that introduces pilot-limited impairments the PINN refines
build_channel_tensor: df AOD_PHI, AOD_THETA, AOA_PHI, AOA_THETA, Pathgain, ToA, PHASE
Dataset section: Remcom Wireless Insite ray-tracing
RSS maps 50_15GHz.jpg, 50_8GHz.jpg used as side information
NMSE in dB results table vs PhysicsInformedLoss.calculate_nmse
global normalization by max(|H_init|,|H_true|) applied before splitting (seed 42)
